serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: That huge building…
You: This is where you live? 
Big Daddy: Haha, yeah. One of my friends got me hooked up with a great property dealer.
You: It’s one of the best places to live in this part of the city, good for you.
Big Daddy: If you say so. Personally, I try to not attach much importance to material stuff. It takes your attention from things that are truly important.
Easy to say when you are rich…
